qualifier: damage sensing, ADP-ribosylation and end-joining repair choice
name: Double-strand break sensing, ADP-ribosylation and end-joining choice
rationale: All members concern early DSB sensing, ATM/BRCA1 signaling, PARP ADP-ribosylation and regulation of NHEJ versus HR, whereas confusables carry HR execution steps (resection, strand exchange, D-loop resolution, SSA).

qualifier: steroids, vitamin D and retinoic acid
name: Cytochrome P450 steroid, vitamin D and retinoic acid metabolism
rationale: Members are CYP-catalysed steroidogenesis, vitamin D and retinoid metabolism and their CYP-defect diseases, unlike confusables centred on phosphate/mineral homeostasis, steroid secretion control or vitamin K.

qualifier: DC differentiation and CD4 T cell costimulation
name: Dendritic cell differentiation and costimulatory CD4 T cell activation
rationale: Members cover dendritic cell differentiation/activation and the costimulation-driven activation and Treg/Th17 differentiation of CD4 T cells, whereas confusables emphasize T cell inhibition, NK receptors and tolerance.

qualifier: chromatin, repair, RNA-binding and cofactor targets
name: SUMOylation of chromatin, repair, RNA-binding and cofactor proteins
rationale: Every member is SUMOylation of a target protein class, distinguished from confusables that add SUMO processing/E1-E2 conjugation machinery, desumoylation and nuclear envelope targets.

name: Branching epithelial maturation and pancreatic ductal-endocrine lineages
rationale: Members share epithelial branching/maturation in kidney and pancreas with later ductal and endocrine pancreatic lineages, unlike confusables covering early pancreatic progenitors, endoderm, lung or salivary gland.

qualifier: aortic and coronary smooth muscle with cardiac growth
name: Cardiac growth and aortic-coronary smooth muscle development
rationale: Members combine heart/cardiomyocyte growth with cardiac, coronary and aortic vascular smooth muscle development, whereas confusables focus on ventricular myocardium proliferation or adult VSMC phenotypic switching.

name: ApoB-lipoprotein clearance with LDL and HDL remodeling
rationale: Members are clearance of VLDL, LDL, chylomicron and triglyceride-rich particles plus LDL/HDL remodeling, while confusables add chylomicron remodeling, lipase assembly, chylomicron assembly and HDL clearance.

name: Copper ion import, transport and detoxification
rationale: All members concern cellular copper handling, whereas confusables cover broad metal responses, metallothioneins, or zinc, manganese, cadmium and iron transport.

name: Cell-surface TLR-MyD88 sensing of LPS and bacterial lipopeptides
rationale: Members cover TLR2/4/5 recognition of LPS, lipopeptides and lipoteichoic acid and MyD88/IRAK4 deficiencies, distinct from confusables built on NOD1/2, inflammasomes and negative cytokine regulation.

name: Nicotinate-based NAD+ salvage and NAD+ catabolism
rationale: Members share nicotinate/pyridine nucleotide salvage and NAD+ catabolism, unlike confusables on de novo NAD+ from tryptophan, coenzyme A or adenine nucleotide interconversion.

name: SREBP-driven activation of cholesterol biosynthesis genes
rationale: Members are SREBP signaling, SREBF target motifs and positive regulation of cholesterol synthesis, whereas confusables involve negative regulation, ChREBP, ATF6 or cholesterol efflux.

name: BAF and CHD/NuRD ATP-dependent chromatin remodeling complexes
rationale: Members center on assembly of BAF variants, CHD subfamilies, NuRD and ChAHP remodelers with associated cofactors, while confusables emphasize histone acetylation, lysine methylation and Polycomb silencing.

name: Pluripotency network and definitive endoderm formation
rationale: Members cover OCT4/SOX2/NANOG pluripotency control and definitive endoderm/foregut specification, whereas confusables focus on mesoderm, primitive streak or pancreatic lineages.

qualifier: PTEN stability and localization, AKT targets
name: PTEN stability, localization and AKT kinase signaling
rationale: Members concern control of PTEN and phosphoinositides and downstream AKT/TORC2 kinase signaling, unlike confusables with PTEN loss, ceRNA translation control, PAK-2p34 or inositol pyrophosphates.

qualifier: adenylate cyclase inhibition by adrenergic, muscarinic, adenosine receptors
name: Adenylate cyclase inhibition by adrenergic, muscarinic and adenosine receptors
rationale: Members are inhibitory GPCR/cyclic nucleotide signaling via alpha-2 adrenergic, muscarinic, adenosine and Gz receptors plus cAMP degradation, whereas confusables carry cyclase activation, PKA and serotonin receptors.

name: Suppression of inflammatory cytokine production and IL-10 regulation
rationale: Members are negative regulation of TNF, IL-1b, IL-6 and IL-12 production with IL-10 regulation, while confusables add TLR/NF-kB signaling regulation or T cell cytokines.

name: Mesenchymal fibroblast matrix and stromal secretory programme
rationale: Members are fibroblast/stromal ECM, EMT and mechanoresponsive matricellular modules, distinct from confusables built on integrin, fibronectin and migration signaling.

name: Extracellular matrix assembly and integrin-collagen receptor signaling
rationale: Members combine ECM modules, fibronectin matrix formation, integrin interactions and collagen-activated receptor signaling, while confusables add stromal/EMT programmes or elastic fibres.

qualifier: endothelial shear stress signaling and integrin activation
name: Shear-stress endothelial signaling and integrin-mediated leukocyte adhesion
rationale: Members cover integrin activation, PECAM1 and leukocyte adhesion to endothelium plus endothelial flow-shear responses, whereas confusables carry diapedesis, extravasation and T cell signatures.

name: Actin filament severing, capping, crosslinking and polymerization dynamics
rationale: Members all regulate actin filament assembly, disassembly and network architecture, unlike confusables focused on filopodia, lamellipodia, leading-edge or focal adhesion structures.

name: Cohesin-mediated sister chromatid cohesion and chromatin looping
rationale: Members cover cohesin loading, establishment, maintenance and resolution of sister chromatid cohesion, while confusables concern condensation, CENP-A deposition, spindle checkpoint or nuclear envelope.

qualifier: contact activation, fibrinolysis and factor defects
name: Plasma coagulation cascade, contact activation and fibrinolysis
rationale: Members are plasma coagulation factors (FVIII, FIX, FV, VWF, FXII) and their defects with fibrin formation and fibrinolysis, whereas confusables emphasize platelet receptor signaling or matrix protease activity.

name: ARF/Rab GTPase control of endocytic recycling and endosome tubulation
rationale: Members share ARF/Rab GTPase regulation of endosome recycling, tubulation and Golgi vesicle budding, distinct from confusables on Golgi-lysosome transport and Golgi organization.

qualifier: NMDA, AMPA and kainate receptor activation and trafficking
name: NMDA, AMPA and kainate receptor activation and trafficking
rationale: Members are activation, trafficking and immediate signaling of ionotropic glutamate receptors, whereas confusables add downstream CREB/CaMK/AMPK transcription, memory and synaptic plasticity regulation.

qualifier: satellite cell maintenance and myogenesis inhibition
name: Satellite cell maintenance and negative regulation of myogenesis
rationale: Members share inhibition of myoblast proliferation/differentiation and satellite stem cell maintenance, unlike confusables with positive myoblast proliferation, fusion, migration or atrophy.
